title: An Investigation of Fear of Progression Among Cancer Patients
official: An Investigation of Fear of Progression Among Cancer Patients
summary:
This scientific study aims to better understand the fear of cancer progression and self-efficacy among people diagnosed with and treated for cancer.

The primary objective of this study is to validate two questionnaires in French among patients currently undergoing cancer treatment: one to assess fear of disease progression, and the other to assess self-efficacy in coping with cancer.

Participation involves completing an online questionnaire.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participants must be 18 years of age or older
* Participants must have been diagnosed with cancer and be currently undergoing treatment for cancer, regardless of its location or stage.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients hospitalized in palliative care,

  * Pregnant or breastfeeding women,
  * Adults under legal guardianship (under guardianship, curatorship, or judicial protection) or who are unable to give informed consent (e.g., due to cognitive impairment),
  * Non-French speakers.
